name: Levels.fyi
tagline: Tech compensation data API for salaries, levels, and offers
description: Levels.fyi offers granular, real-time salary, compensation, and leveling data. API, MCP, or CLI access is request-based; Data Stream API access is listed with the paid Enterprise plan. Public pages do not document REST endpoints, authentication, or request examples.

auth.details: Access model unclear from public docs; community/partner access varies. Verify current auth before use.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No free API tier is published. MCP/API access to the Data Stream is included in Enterprise at $4,000/month with an annual commitment.

compare salary bands across levels at a company
benchmark an offer against market compensation data
find level titles and ranges for a company ladder
